source_state_rate_rule.rule: Interest sourced in one treaty state and paid to a resident of the other state is taxable only in the residence state.

special_cases: The Article 11 exclusive-residence rule does not apply where the interest claim is effectively connected with a source-state permanent establishment or fixed base.

matched_effects_relevant_to_interest.effect: PPT may deny the treaty benefit when obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes unless granting it accords with the object and purpose of the relevant treaty provisions.
